Base is America’s next-generation power company. At Base Power, we’re building a vertically integrated, software enabled battery manufacturing company for the electric era. We are living through a revolutionary free-fall in the cost of internal tools, and at Base we are taking full advantage to build the sharpest, most responsive internal stack in the world.

 

As a software engineer on the Factory Software team, you will be responsible for building the tools we use to purchase, move, manufacture, and deliver batteries to hundreds of thousands of homes. You will work closely with manufacturing engineers, warehouse associates, global supply managers, truck drivers, and quality engineers to build intuitive, reliable tools for controlling and understanding material movement. This is a role for engineers who like working closely with non-software teams, solving messy real world problems, and thinking deeply about how to leverage software to streamline processes.

 - Set the pace: Move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and take responsibility for outcomes. You help the team operate with clarity and urgency.

 - Ability to design systems end-to-end, from API design through implementation and operation, with sound engineering judgment




ABOUT THE TEAM

We work directly with supply-chain, warehouse, procurement, and finance partners to understand how work happens and where software needs to change. Our work spans operational tools and the integrations that connect physical activity to financial records. We’re replacing legacy ERP workflows with Base-owned systems to reduce duplicate entry, manual reconciliation, and errors, and give our partners data they can trust.

Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Radar ML team builds the machine learning systems that power Stripe’s Radar fraud and abuse product suite. Our models make real-time decisions across a significant share of internet commerce - helping businesses stop fraud, increase authorization, and grow safely. By turning economy-scale datasets into compelling ML products, the team directly improves customer outcomes and drives meaningful revenue for Stripe.
  
  
The team is growing, and expanding into multiple new areas. We are building abuse protections across the full customer life-cycle, adaptive and customizable fraud systems for enterprises, and risk intelligence for 50+ global payment methods.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
You will own ML problems from conception to production: analyzing new fraud and abuse patterns, exploring large-scale datasets, experimenting with model architectures, designing evaluations, deploying models, and monitoring performance.
  
  
Your work may include developing transformer architectures for payment data, building graph-powered intelligence across consumers, leveraging LLMs to detect emerging attacks, or rapidly prototyping new protections with frontier AI labs.
  
  
You will have opportunities to ship 0→1 products, and to improve mission-critical ML models operating at Stripe scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build, train, evaluate, and deploy models that detect fraud and abuse across Stripe’s global network.
* Investigate emerging fraud and abuse patterns, identify where ML can help, and rapidly develop effective solutions.
* Design features, datasets, evaluation methods, and experiments for noisy, delayed, and adversarial environments.
* Improve model architectures, training methods, and production systems to increase model quality, coverage, and adaptability.
* Monitor production behavior and improve models as data, customer needs, and attack patterns change.
* Balance model quality with legitimate-user impact, latency, reliability, and operational complexity.
* Partner with engineering, product, data science, risk experts, and leading Stripe users to turn modeling improvements into differentiated Radar products.
* Contribute to reusable tools and AI-assisted workflows that help the team develop and operate ML systems more effectively.

Who you are
  
  
You are a fast, pragmatic problem solver with deep ML expertise and a bias toward action. You are excited to work at the frontier of payments and AI - turning advances in machine learning into production systems that address new forms of fraud and abuse. You’ve built ML models and shepherded them to production, landing impact for users.
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, data analysis, statistics, model evaluation, and experiment design.
* Strong programming and software-engineering skills, with experience writing tested, maintainable code for production ML applications.
* Experience building or operating production ML systems, including one or more of large-scale data and feature pipelines, distributed model training, low-latency inference, model deployment, or production monitoring.
* Ability to investigate ambiguous problems, reason from data, and choose pragmatic technical approaches.
* Ability to communicate technical ideas and results clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience owning an ML problem across the full lifecycle, from problem framing and data exploration through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Experience developing or productionizing modern deep learning, graph-learning, or LLM-based approaches.
* Experience building and optimizing real-time, low-latency ML systems at scale.
* Experience applying ML to fraud detection, integrity, trust and safety, identity, cybersecurity, or another adversarial domain.
* Experience rapidly building 0→1 products, working directly with customers, or operating effectively in a fast-moving environment.
* Active interest in the latest ML developments, and how they can be leveraged to solve business problems.

Hybrid work at Stripe

Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Radar ML team builds the machine learning systems that power Stripe’s Radar fraud and abuse product suite. Our models make real-time decisions across a significant share of internet commerce - helping businesses stop fraud, increase authorization, and grow safely. By turning economy-scale datasets into compelling ML products, the team directly improves customer outcomes and drives meaningful revenue for Stripe.
  
  
The team is growing, and expanding into multiple new areas. We are building abuse protections across the full customer life-cycle, adaptive and customizable fraud systems for enterprises, and risk intelligence for 50+ global payment methods.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
You will own ML problems from conception to production: analyzing new fraud and abuse patterns, exploring large-scale datasets, experimenting with model architectures, designing evaluations, deploying models, and monitoring performance.
  
  
Your work may include developing transformer architectures for payment data, building graph-powered intelligence across consumers, leveraging LLMs to detect emerging attacks, or rapidly prototyping new protections with frontier AI labs.
  
  
You will have opportunities to ship 0→1 products, and to improve mission-critical ML models operating at Stripe scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build, train, evaluate, and deploy models that detect fraud and abuse across Stripe’s global network.
* Investigate emerging fraud and abuse patterns, identify where ML can help, and rapidly develop effective solutions.
* Design features, datasets, evaluation methods, and experiments for noisy, delayed, and adversarial environments.
* Improve model architectures, training methods, and production systems to increase model quality, coverage, and adaptability.
* Monitor production behavior and improve models as data, customer needs, and attack patterns change.
* Balance model quality with legitimate-user impact, latency, reliability, and operational complexity.
* Partner with engineering, product, data science, risk experts, and leading Stripe users to turn modeling improvements into differentiated Radar products.
* Contribute to reusable tools and AI-assisted workflows that help the team develop and operate ML systems more effectively.

Who you are
  
  
You are a fast, pragmatic problem solver with deep ML expertise and a bias toward action. You are excited to work at the frontier of payments and AI - turning advances in machine learning into production systems that address new forms of fraud and abuse. You’ve built ML models and shepherded them to production, landing impact for users.
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience developing, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.
* Strong foundations in machine learning, data analysis, statistics, model evaluation, and experiment design.
* Strong programming and software-engineering skills, with experience writing tested, maintainable code for production ML applications.
* Experience building or operating production ML systems, including one or more of large-scale data and feature pipelines, distributed model training, low-latency inference, model deployment, or production monitoring.
* Ability to investigate ambiguous problems, reason from data, and choose pragmatic technical approaches.
* Ability to communicate technical ideas and results clearly and collaborate effectively across disciplines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience owning an ML problem across the full lifecycle, from problem framing and data exploration through deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
* Experience developing or productionizing modern deep learning, graph-learning, or LLM-based approaches.
* Experience building and optimizing real-time, low-latency ML systems at scale.
* Experience applying ML to fraud detection, integrity, trust and safety, identity, cybersecurity, or another adversarial domain.
* Experience rapidly building 0→1 products, working directly with customers, or operating effectively in a fast-moving environment.
* Active interest in the latest ML developments, and how they can be leveraged to solve business problems.

 Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans — including many of the top 20 and representing more than 270 million lives — Machinify brings together a fully configurable, content\-rich, AI\-powered platform along with best\-in\-class expertise. We're constantly reimagining what's possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're building production\-grade agentic systems that audit medical claims end\-to\-end — reading raw medical records, reasoning over coding and clinical guidelines, and producing defensible findings that hold up to clinical and regulatory review. Reaching human\-expert accuracy on noisy, long\-context documents is one of the hardest unsolved problems in applied AI, and the field is moving weekly.
   

  

 We're hiring an L4 AI Engineer who can step into an ambiguous problem, design an agent system from scratch, and ship it. You won't be plugging into someone else's architecture — you'll be deciding what the architecture should be.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design agent systems from first principles. Decide the loop, the tools, the context strategy, the evaluation harness. Choose between single\-agent and multi\-agent topologies, between LLM reasoning and deterministic post\-passes, between retrieval and direct context loading — and defend the choice with data.
* Engineer the context. The hardest part of building a good agent is what goes into the prompt and what comes out. You'll obsess over context windows, tool surfaces, structured outputs, citation grounding, and the prompt itself.
* Drive evaluation rigor. Build evals before you build the agent. Diagnose where it fails, fix the root cause, and prove the fix moved the metric.
* Use AI tooling like a power user. A meaningful fraction of your day will be spent driving Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools to plan, scaffold, refactor, and debug your own work. We expect you to be faster with these tools than most engineers are without them.
* Become a domain expert. Healthcare claims, coding guidelines, and the medical record itself are unavoidable parts of the job. Strong engineers who lean into the domain become outsized contributors here.


**Required**
**What We're Looking For**
* 2–4 years of applied ML / AI engineering experience with a Bachelor's in CS, Math, Engineering or equivalent — or a Master's in a similar program with no prior industry experience required. Either way, at least one production\-quality system (industry, research, or substantial open\-source) you owned end\-to\-end.
* Strong Python engineering. Clean abstractions, type discipline, async, tested code.
* Deep, hands\-on understanding of agent loops — how a model decides to call a tool, how a tool result re\-enters context, how loops terminate, where they fail.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major agent SDK — OpenAI Agents SDK, Anthropic SDK / claude\-agent\-sdk, LangGraph, or equivalent — and an opinion on the tradeoffs.
* Working knowledge of how modern coding agents are built and how they engineer context — what goes in the system prompt, how files are read and edited, how long\-running tasks are planned and tracked, where they break.
* Fluency with Claude Code / Codex as a power user. You should be able to brainstorm, plan, and execute non\-trivial engineering tasks with these tools — including reading their source when needed to understand or extend behavior.
* Solid command of VS Code and git — branches, rebases, worktrees, conflict resolution, PR workflows. Not optional.
* A bias toward measurement: you don't ship without an eval, and you don't believe a number you can't reproduce.


**Strongly Preferred**
* Experience designing structured outputs (Pydantic / JSON Schema) and tool interfaces that LLMs reliably call correctly.
* Familiarity with reasoning models (o\-series, Claude extended thinking, Gemini thinking) and a sense of when they earn their cost.
* Prior work on long\-context, citation\-grounded systems where the model must point to evidence, not just answer.
* Healthcare, legal, finance, or any other domain where "mostly right" is unacceptable.


**Nice to have**
* Document understanding (OCR, layout\-aware models, table extraction).
* Vision\-language models, multimodal retrieval.
* Production experience with caching, observability, and cost control on LLM workloads.


**What We Offer**
* Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital\-first.
* Top Medical/Dental/Vision offerings
* FSA/HSA
* Tuition reimbursement
* Competitive salary, 401(k) with company match
* Unlimited PTO
* Additional health and wellness benefits and perks
* Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work


 The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels and the base salary can range from $130k\-$200k\+ based on your assessed level. Compensation also includes meaningful equity, healthcare, unlimited PTO, and more.
